get_section:necb:2025:8.4.6.9.full_text:
1) The fuel consumption at part-load conditions, Fuelpartload, in Btu/h, of the reference fuel-fired service water heater shall be derived by applying an adjustment factor to the fuel consumption at full load:
Fuelpartload = Fueldesign FHeatPLC
where
Fueldesign = fuel consumption at design conditions, in Btu/h, and FHeatPLC = fuel heating part-load efficiency curve determined in accordance with Sentence (2).
2) The fuel heating part-load efficiency curve, FHeatPLC, shall be calculated using the following equation:
FHeatPLC = a + b +cx (Qartload) 2
where
Qpartload = service water heater capacity at part-load conditions, in Btu/h, Qdesign = service water heater capacity at design conditions, in Btu/h, a = 0.021826, b = 0.977630, and C = 0.000543.
